content: actions/checkout@v4 default fetch-depth is 1 (single commit): git diff HEAD^ fails in CI unless fetch-depth: 2. Per official actions/checkout README. Implication: bib sync reminder in CI either uses git show HEAD:papers/ref.bib (works at depth 1, compares working tree vs HEAD — naturally no-op in CI) or skips reminder in CI; CONTEXT discretion allows CI skip.
